Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
Mr. Anil Anthwal, Advocate, for the
petitioner.
Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, Brief Holder,
for the State/ respondents.
Petitioner was appointed as Assistant
Teacher in a Governm ent Primary School,
Prem pur Loshgyani, Haldwani in District
Nainital in the year 2005. Subsequently, vide
order dated 27.1.2021, he was prom oted as
Headm aster and was transferred from
Government Prim ary School, Prem pur
Loshgyani, Haldwani to Governm ent Prim ary
School, Dham orim oda, Block Okhalkanda in
District Nainital. Feeling aggrieved by his
transfer from Block Haldwani to Block
Okhalkanda, petitioner has approached this
Court.
Learned Counsel for the petitioner
contends that in the past, Assistant Teachers
serving in Governm ent Prim ary School were
prom oted as Headm aster in the sam e
school. I n support of this contention, he has
relied upon a prom otion order dated
30.6.2020, passed by District Education
Officer (Prim ary), Nainital. Thus, he submits
that petitioner has been subjected to hostile
discrimination by not prom oting him in the
sam e school where he was serving as
Assistant Teacher.
Per contra, learned State Counsel
submits that petitioner was transferred on
prom otion from Block Haldwani to Block
Okhalkanda and petitioner has served at

Sugam places throughout his service career,
therefore, as per provisions of Transfer Act,
he was liable to be transferred to a Durgam
place. He further submits that petitioner
does not have any legally enforceable right
to seek prom otion in the sam e school, where
he was serving at the time of prom otion. He
further submits that the com petent authority
has to look into various aspects while
transferring a teacher on prom otion,
therefore, there is no substance in the
challenge thrown by petitioner to the
prom otion order dated 27.1.2021.
Learned Counsel for the petitioner
submits that vide order dated 5.5.2021, a
coordinate Bench of this Court granted
protection to petitioner by directing the
parties to m aintain status quo. He thus
submits that pursuant to the said interim
order, petitioner is still serving at
Government Prim ary School, Prem pur
Loshgyani, Haldwani.
Admittedly, petitioner is a
governm ent servant, who holds a
transferable post, therefore, the grievance
raised by petitioner against his transfer from
Block Haldwani to Block Okhalkanda is
without any substance. As pointed out by
learned State Counsel, this is not a case of
transfer sim pliciter, on the other hand,
petitioner is transferred on promotion.
Therefore, in the absence of any
infraction of statutory provisions,
interference with such transfer order would
be unwarranted, especially when there is no
allegation of m alice or ill will against anyone.
However, having regard to the submission
m ade by learned Counsel for the petitioner
that in the past, som e teachers were
prom oted in the sam e school, writ petition is

disposed of with liberty to petitioner to m ake
representation to District Education Officer
(Elementary), Nainital within two weeks from
today. Representation, if m ade within
stipulated tim e, shall be decided by the
concerned authority within eight weeks from
the date of its receipts.
I nterim order passed by this Court
shall continue to operate for a period of ten
weeks or till the decision on petitioner's
representation, whichever is earlier.
 ( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
